purpose: Select one genuinely independent Campaign041 mechanism without reading minute candidate values, comparison values, daily prices, or historical returns.

candidate_queue_review.reason: It measures whether a nonzero interbar transaction-price discontinuity at the current open is completely revisited by the current minute high-low interval. It is a price-continuity and immediate liquidity-absorption mechanism, not a distribution of high-low range mass, an entropy, a return path statistic, or a terminal-factor combination.
Magnitude weighting would mix the absorption event with a second unregistered range or volatility exposure and introduce a tunable scaling choice.
A sign split would create two thinner supports and invite a post-result directional rescue.
Entropy and concentration of intraday range mass are already terminally represented and are explicitly outside the Campaign041 boundary.
Lunch and overnight discontinuities have different information sets and liquidity regimes from adjacent one-minute transitions.
A zero gap contains no discontinuity to absorb and would mechanically turn the candidate into a price-update or open-equality statistic.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_microgap_absorption_share_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger share of nonzero one-minute opening discontinuities that are completely revisited within the same minute may indicate resilient liquidity provision and rapid absorption of small order-flow shocks, which may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: Across the 119 adjacent transitions inside each 120-bar half session, let g_t=log(open_t/close_(t-1)). A transition is informative only when g_t is exactly nonzero. An informative transition is absorbed when low_t <= close_(t-1) <= high_t. Return absorbed_informative_transition_count / informative_transition_count.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value mechanism-overlap audit and bind the exact formula, direction, source projection, transition support, zero-gap rule, OHLC ordering, and forbidden variants before any candidate value is computed.
